HelpPage_AchievementDescription: The game can be won in many different ways based on what you are trying to get out of life. See Life Goals to see all possible winning conditions
HelpPage_Attribute_Happiness: Measures your happiness, reduced by events and over working. You will commit suicide if your happiness is zero for too long
HelpPage_Attribute_Health: Measures your physical health. This is affected by your diet and age. Your health will decline as you age, no one lives forever
HelpPage_Attribute_Sanity: Measures your mental health, reduced by stressful jobs and spouses, or poor living conditions. If your sanity reaches zero for too long, your character will go insane
HelpPage_Bank: Shows how much money is in your bank. While the money in your bank cannot be directly used, it will generate interest
HelpPage_Bankruptcy: You will go bankrupt if you debt reaches 2x your credit limit
HelpPage_CashFlow: Your weekly cash flow is the summary of your financial health, with itemized costs and earnings per week
HelpPage_Children: You can have children once you are married. Your relationship with your children must not reach zero before they become an adult or they will be taken by Child Protection Services
HelpPage_CreditLimit: Your credit limit is based on the degree you have. The higher the degree, the higher the limit
HelpPage_Family: You can live in your parent's house and eat their food for free until you turn 18. Better relationship with your parents means larger allowances and inheritance when they pass
HelpPage_Love: Having a partner can come with various weekly bonuses based on the partner's personality. Marrying your partner will double their bonus
HelpPage_PerksDescription: Perks can be activated at the start of each life to enable bonuses. Perks can be earned upon the completion of certain life goals
HelpPage_Wallet: Shows how much money you have in your wallet. Only money in your wallet can be directly used for actions
HelpSection_Business: Businesses generate recurring revenue. They can be upgrade or expanded to increase employee or store capacity
HelpSection_Career: Careers have different promotional ladders that can be climbed, with exception of basic low skill jobs. Some careers will require more advanced degrees for more advanced promotions
HelpSection_CommittingCrime: Committing crime can be quite profitable but there is a chance you might be arrested. As you become a more experienced criminal, your chances of being caught is reduced and you will be able to reap additional rewards
HelpSection_Jail: You will have to serve out your sentence if you are caught when committing a crime. Most actions are not available while in jail. You can attempt an escape at the risk of getting additional jail sentence
HelpSection_SideHustle: Side hustles are personal side projects that can generate recurring income. As you complete more side projects, your experience will result in better, higher earning projects
